label: sec:ns-obstruction-intro
html:
The global regularity theorem for the q-deformed system isolates the classical Navier--Stokes question as a degeneration problem as q \to 1. This section defines the internal topological invariant \mathrm{NS}(A) = e(\xi) \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{Z}) on the spectral surface \mathcal{S}, records its scope relative to the classical three-dimensional PDE, and evaluates the Reeb bundle topology and Reeb Beltrami flow on the Descartes quantum universe.

Remark: What observability means for the brane fluid translates the QOU observability axiom into fluid terms. Remark: Independent motivation for observability: why \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 is not an NS assumption verifies the axiom's structural independence. Definition: The substrate line bundle and the \mathbb{G}_m-family of differentials elevates the substrate parameter into a section of a line bundle. Remark: The substrate parameter as a \mathbb{G}_m-section: torsion, specialisation, and the q = 1 boundary tracks the limit behaviour, while Theorem: Observability is a base property: \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 is independent of the substrate section confirms observability survives the family deformation intact. The geometry of the vorticity field enters through Proposition: The Levi datum of the vorticity plane field is the single scalar \xi\cdot\mathrm{curl}\,\xi, which Remark: Reading the Levi scalar: twist of the vortex lines, not core shape interprets.

This section states Definition: NS-regular quantum observable universe and Definition: NS obstruction class \mathrm{NS}(A), situating them beside the classical PDE question in Remark: The classical regularity question for the Navier--Stokes equation (where \mathrm{NS}(A) = e(\xi) is an internal surface Euler class rather than a deductive three-dimensional PDE blowup proof). Three remarks examine the lifting interpretation at q > 1 and q \to 1. In the next section, Proposition: Conditional collision-locus criterion for the NS obstruction tower and Proposition: Conditional decomposition of local Euler-index and jet-divergence terms at a collision locus record the conditional curve-restriction framework together with its topological obstruction on a one-dimensional collision curve \Sigma \subset \mathcal{S}: because H^2(\Sigma, \cdot) = 0, every surface class restricts to zero on \Sigma. Theorem: Topology of the Reeb bundle of the Descartes universe proves e(\xi) = -6 \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{Z}), Kummer persistence for n \notin \{1, 2, 3, 6\}, and \kappa_n|_\Sigma = 0 on any one-dimensional locus \Sigma, while Proposition: Reeb Beltrami flow on \mathrm{UT}(\Sigma_4) exhibits an explicit globally smooth incompressible Navier--Stokes solution on \mathrm{UT}(\Sigma_4) \times [0, \infty).

This is contrasted with Example: The torus quantum universe: \chi(A) = 0 and NS regularity. Definition: Observable modular tensor category at q = \zeta_N and Proposition: Braid group action on \mathbf{V}^{\otimes n} does not factor through S_n isolate the braided structure of the state space. The following section, Approaches and open problems, examines the open analytical bridges at q \to 1.
